title: Future Tense (Star Trek: Enterprise)
premise_summary: "Future Tense" is the 42nd episode of the television series Star Trek: Enterprise, the 16th of the second season. Set in the 22nd century of the Star Trek universe, a spaceship and its crew deal with aliens as they explore space.
